Surface.description: Geometric carrier of the face, inline (the face *is* this surface).

OuterLoop.description: Reference to the outer-boundary loop node (CCW seen from surface normal)

InnerLoops.description: References to inner-boundary loop nodes (holes through the face)

SameSense.description: If false, the surface normal is reversed to give the face's outward normal

description: Face node body — a surface bounded by an outer loop and optional inner loops.

BrepRef.description:
Relative- or absolute-path reference to another Brep topology node, wrapped in
angle brackets (USD relationship-target syntax). `../` ascends one segment
relative to the referencing node's composed path; a leading `/` is absolute.
Examples: "<../Edge_3>", "<../Vertex_0>".
